about: Dictation quality test set (owner 2026-11-14). Made-up people, places, amounts and dates only. Each case is spoken by 2-3 Windows SAPI voices, transcribed by whisper and polished by Glim; the checklist is scored by voice::quality_tests.

checklist.keep: every listed name, number, date and time appears in the typed text (numbers compared by their digits; 0-10 may be written as words)
checklist.absent: words that a filler or a spoken correction removed must not appear (as whole words)
checklist.invented: no number the transcript doesn't have, no capitalized name the transcript doesn't have
checklist.length: between 40% and 130% of the transcript's words (chat: at most 60 words)
checklist.register: email: sentences ending in punctuation, a greeting only if one was said; chat: no 'Dear'/'Best regards'/'Sincerely'; documents: no greeting or sign-off
